article.story: Vanderbilt (3-0) at Auburn (2-1), Sept. 26 at 4:15 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Auburn by 9.5. Against the spread: Auburn 1-2, Vanderbilt 1-2. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Auburn Offense Overall: 457.3 yards per game (43rd in FBS) Passing: 265.7 yards per game (44th) Rushing: 191.7 yards per game (44th) Scoring: 33.0 points per game (60th) Auburn Defense Overall: 384.0 yards per game (102nd in FBS) Passing: 252.0 yards per game (119th) Rushing: 132.0 yards per game (75th) Scoring: 22.7 points per game (71st) Vanderbilt Offense Overall: 381.3 yards per game (86th in FBS) Passing: 241.7 yards per game (61st) Rushing: 139.7 yards per game (99th) Scoring: 32.7 points per game (62nd) Vanderbilt Defense Overall: 320.7 yards per game (63rd in FBS) Passing: 212.0 yards per game (78th) Rushing: 108.7 yards per game (46th) Scoring: 22.0 points per game (69th) Auburn ranks 24th in FBS in third down percentage, converting 50.0% of the time. Vanderbilt is 121st in the FBS with 75.0 penalty yards per game. Auburn ranks 113th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75.0% of trips. Auburn is 126th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:00. Team leaders Auburn Passing: Byrum Brown, 753 yards, 5 TDs, 4 INTs, 64.3 completion percentage Rushing: Brown, 180 yards on 52 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Keshaun Singleton, 230 yards on 17 catches, 1 TD Vanderbilt Passing: Jared Curtis, 547 yards, 4 TDs, 2 INTs, 63.1 completion percentage Rushing: Sedrick Alexander, 152 yards on 26 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Junior Sherrill, 272 yards on 15 catches, 2 TDs Last game Auburn was defeated by Florida 44-39 on Sept. 19. Brown threw for 271 yards on 20-of-35 attempts (57.1%) with three touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 18 times for 65 yards and one rushing touchdown. Jeremiah Cobb had 32 rushing yards on nine carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for 11 yards. Singleton put up 99 yards on seven catches with one touchdown. Vanderbilt won 35-31 over NC State on Sept. 19. Curtis threw for 277 yards on 20-of-34 attempts (58.8%) with three touchdowns and two interceptions. He also carried the ball 12 times for 64 yards. Alexander carried the ball seven times for 53 yards, adding two receptions for 15 yards and one touchdown. Sherrill had six receptions for 108 yards and two touchdowns. Next game Auburn plays at No. 14 Tennessee on Oct. 3. Vanderbilt plays at No. 2 Georgia on Oct. 3.
